test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The radius of curvature of a spherical mirror is the distance between:

options.text: principal focus and centre of curvature

solution:
The correct answer is** __centre of curvature and pole.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A spherical mirror's radius of curvature is equal to the radius of the circle it is a part of.
